events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture, began on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and magic of Woodstock began. What's your favourite performance from the legendary festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away at his Graceland mansion in Memphis, Tennessee in 1977.

angles.name: The King's legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day. His music still shakes the world.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas in 1996, an event we mark on this day.

angles.name: Tupac's impact
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur on hip-hop and culture, whose life was tragically cut short. His words still resonate.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London in 1970, an event we mark on this day.

angles.name: Jimi's guitar genius
angles.copy: Today we remember Jimi Hendrix, a true innovator whose guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring its famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road album
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in music history!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the distinctive lead singer and songwriter of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style are simply iconic.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and successful solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock and roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's enduring message
angles.copy: 'Imagine' all the people... still living life in peace. John Lennon's timeless anthem was released on this day.

events.title: First Apple iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: The original iPod
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed portable music forever. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder and solo artist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated English comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! What's your favourite of his many iconic roles?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: The Beatles' groundbreaking 'White Album' was unleashed on the world on this day. So many incredible tracks on one double LP!

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The iconic lead singer of Queen, Freddie Mercury, passed away at the age of 45 in London in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose incredible voice and stage presence continue to inspire. We miss you, legend.
